correctness.rationale: Derived independently the 31-point/155-plane/155-line counts in PG(4,2), 7 planes per line. For each pair of selected line copies, intersecting distinct lines contribute 1 to point-pair S and plane-pair J, repeated lines contribute 3 and 7, yielding J=S+4D. At m=34, degree convexity gives S>=120 but J<=floor(238/2)=119, contradiction. At m=33 a doubled line forbids any other selected line meeting it, giving S>=114, D>=1, J>=118>floor(231/2)=115. If simple, S=J ranges 111..115, yielding five triples. Independently enumerated all 155 planes and 155 lines and checked the cited 32-line witness has occupancy 43 empty and 112 double planes. This proves a 33 upper bound, not equality.
